title: Edvard Munch, Self-Portrait, 500 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: digtal printing, microprinting, agate stone insert

descriptionPlain: Description Edvard Munch – 160th anniversary of the artist’s birth Masterpiece of world painting at your fingertips Decorated with a dedicated stone in the color of the painting Perfect gift for art lovers Original numismatic project Edvard Munch, the creator of the famous „The Scream”, depicted in his paintings the deep emotions and fears of the human soul. His works were a reflection of inner conflicts and unrest. A coin with the image of one of his works is a fragment of art history, struck in pure silver. A perfect addition to your collection.
